गर-द (I) a. poisoning, administering poison.
गर-द (II) n. poison.

गरित a. (f. ता) Poisoned.
गरिमन् m. 1. Weight, heaviness, Sis.ix.49; 2. importance, dignity; 3. worth, excellence; 4. one of the eight siddhis or faculties of a yogin by which he can make himself heavy at will. See ईशिता.
गरिष्ठ a. (f. ष्ठा) 1. Heaviest; 2. most important, &c., (super. of गुरु a. q.v.).

गरुड m. 1. Name of a huge bird, son of कश्यप and विनता, the chief of the feathered race, the enemy of serpents, and the vehicle of Viṣṇu; 2. a building shaped like Garuḍa; 3. name of a particular military array.
गारुड (I) a. (f. डी) 1. Shaped like Garuḍa; 2. coming from or relating to Garuḍa.
गारुड (II) m.n. 1. Gold; 2. an emerald, R.xiii.53; 3. a charm against poison; 4. a missile presided over by Garuḍa.
गरुड-अग्रज m. an epithet of Aruṇa, the charioteer of the sun.
गरुड-अंक m. an epithet of Viṣṇu.
गरुड-अंकित न्।, -अश्मन् म्।, -उत्तीर्ण न्। n. an emerald.
गरुड-अश्मन् m. an emerald.
गरुड-अंकित न्।, -अश्मन् म्।, -उत्तीर्ण न्। n. an emerald.
गरुड-ध्वज m. an epithet of Viṣṇu.
गरुड-व्यूह m. a particular military array. (See गरुड 3).
गरुत् m. 1. The wing of a bird; 2. eating, swallowing.
गरुत्-मत् m. 1. Garuḍa, गरुत्मदाशीविषभीमलक्षणैः R.iii.57; 2. a bird in gencral.
गरुत्-योधिन् m. a quail.
गरुल m. Garuḍa, the chief of birds.
गर्ग (I) m. 1. Name of an old sage, one of the sons of Brahman (m.); 2. a bull; 3. an earth worm.
गर्ग (II) m. pl. The descendants of Garga.
गर्ग-स्रोतस् n. the name of a Tīrtha.
गर्गर m. 1. A whirlpool, an eddy; 2. a kind of musical instrument; 3. a kind of fish; 4. a churn.
गर्गरी f. A churn, a vessel for holding water.
गर्गाट m. A kind of fish.

गर्ज् (I) vi. ???P (pp. गर्जित) 1. To thunder, to emit a deep sound, गर्जति शरदि न वर्षति वर्षति वर्षासु निःस्वनो मेघः Ud.; 2. to roar, to growl, कुंभकर्णस्ततोऽगर्जीत् Bt.xv.21, हृष्टो गर्जति चातिदर्पितबलो दुर्योधनो वा शिखी Mrich.v., गर्जन् हरिः सांभसि शैलकुंजे Bt.ii.9.With अनु-, to thunder in return, to echo, K.S.vi.40.With प्रति-, 1. to roar at, to roar against; 2. to resist, to oppose, अयोह्रदयः प्रतिगर्जिताम् R.ix.9.
गर्ज् (II) vi. 10U (pp. गर्जित) To sound, to roar, to thunder.
गर्ज m. 1. The roaring of elephants; 2. the rumbling of clouds.
गर्जा f. The thundering of clouds.
गर्जन n. 1. Sound, noise, growl, roaring; 2. passion, wrath; 3. war, battle; 4. reproach.
गर्जि m. The thundering of clouds.
गर्जित (I) a. (f. ता) Sounded, roared.
गर्जित (II) n. The thunder of clouds.
गर्जित (III) m. A roaring elephant in rut.
गर्जित (I) a. (f. ता) Sounded, roared.
गर्त (I) m.n. A hollow, a hole, a cave, ससत्वेषु गर्तेषु M.iv.47.
गर्त (II) m. 1. The hollow of the loins; 2. a kind of disease; 3. name of a country, a part of the Trigartas.
गर्ता f. A hole, a ditch, a cave.
गर्त-आश्रय m. an animal living in holes or underground, e.g. a mouse, a rat.
गर्तिका f. A weaver’s workshop (so called on account of the weaver sitting at his loom with his feet in a hole below the level of the floor).
गर्द् vi. 1P, 10U (pres. गर्दति, गर्दयति-ते) To sound, to roar.
गर्दभ (I) m. 1. An ass (fem. ˚भी), अविश्रांतं वहेद्भारं शीतोष्णं च न विंदति । ससंतोषस्तथा नित्यं त्रीणि शिक्षेत गर्दभात् Cāṇakya., M.viii.298; 2. smell, odour.
गर्दभ (II) n. The white water-lily.
गार्दभ a. (f. भी) Belonging to or coming from an ass, asinine.
गर्दभ-अंड, -अंडक m. 1. name of a particular tree; 2. a tree in general.
गर्दभ-अंड, -अंडक m. 1. name of a particular tree; 2. a tree in general.
गर्दभ-आह्वय n. a white lotus.
गर्दभ-गद m. a particular disease of the skin.
गर्ध m. Desire, greediness, eagerness.
गर्धन a. (f. ना) Covetous, greedy.
गर्धन a. (f. ना) Covetous, greedy.
गर्धिन् a. (f. नी) 1. Desirous, greedy, covetous, M.iv.28; 2. pursuing with eagerness.
गर्धिन् a. (f. नी) 1. Desirous, greedy, covetous, M.iv.28; 2. pursuing with eagerness.

गर्भ m. 1. The womb, the belly, पुनर्गर्भे च संभवम् M.vi.63; 2. a fœtus or embryo, गर्भोऽभवद्भूधरराजपत्न्याः K.S.i.19, अनुष्ठिते भिषग्भिराप्तैरथ गर्भभर्माणि R.iii.12, ii.75; 3. the time of conception, e.g. गर्भाष्टमेऽब्दे कुर्वंति ब्राह्मणस्योपनायनम्; 4. a child, the brood or offspring of birds; 5. the offspring of the sky, i.e. the vapours drawn upwards by the rays of the sun during eight months and sent down again in the rainy season; 6. the inside, the middle, the interior of any thing, निधानगर्भामिव सागरांबरात् R.iii.9, अग्निगर्भां शमीमिव Sak.iv., R.v.17, ix.55, Sis.ix.62; 7. an inner apartment, a lying-in chamber; 8. any interior chamber; 9. a hole; 10. food; 11. fire; 12. the rough coat of the fruit of the jack (पनस); 13. the bed of a river especially of the Ganges on the fourteenth day of the dark half of Bhādrapada when the river is fullest.
गार्भ a. (f. र्भी) 1. Uterine; 2. relating to jestation, M.ii.27.
गर्भांक m. an interlude during an act. (It is thus defined in the S.D.- अंकोदरप्रविष्टो यो रंगद्वारामुखादिमान् । अंकोऽपरः सगर्भांकः सबीजः फलवानपि) e.g. सीतास्वयंवर in the Bālarāmāyaṇa.
गर्भांक m. an interlude during an act. (It is thus defined in the S.D.- अंकोदरप्रविष्टो यो रंगद्वारामुखादिमान् । अंकोऽपरः सगर्भांकः सबीजः फलवानपि) e.g. सीतास्वयंवर in the Bālarāmāyaṇa.
गर्भ-अवक्रांति f. descent of the soul into the womb.
गर्भ-अगार n. 1. uterus; 2. an inner and private room, a female apartment; 3. lying-in chamber; 4. the sanctuary of a temple, the chamber where the image of a deity is placed.
गर्भ-आधान n. 1. impregnation, गर्भाधानक्षणपरिचयान्नूनमाबद्धमालाः (बलाकाः) Megh.i.9; 2. a purificatory ceremony performed after menstruation to ensure and sanctify conception, गर्भाधानमृतौ Yaj.i.11.
गर्भ-आशय m. the uterus, the womb.
गर्भ-शय्या f. the abode of the fœtus, the uterus.
गर्भ-आस्राव m. mis-carriage, abortion.
गर्भ-स्राव m. an abortion, mis-carriage, Yaj.iii.2, M.v.66.
गर्भ-ईश्वर m. a sovereign by birth.
गर्भ-उत्पत्ति f. the formation of the embryo.
गर्भ-उपघात m. mis-carriage.
गर्भ-उपघातिनी f. a cow or female miscarrying from unseasonable jestation.
गर्भ-कर a. procreative.
गर्भ-काल m. time of impregnation.
गर्भ-कोश, -कोष m. uterus.
गर्भ-कोश, -कोष m. uterus.
गर्भ-क्लेश m. pains caused by the embryo, throes of childbirth.
गर्भ-क्षय m. miscarriage.
गर्भ-गृह, -भवन, -वेश्मन् n. 1. an inner apartment; 2. a lying-in chamber; 3. the sanctuary of a temple, e.g. निर्गत्य गर्भभवनात् M.M.i.
गर्भ-गृह, -भवन, -वेश्मन् n. 1. an inner apartment; 2. a lying-in chamber; 3. the sanctuary of a temple, e.g. निर्गत्य गर्भभवनात् M.M.i.
गर्भ-गृह, -भवन, -वेश्मन् n. 1. an inner apartment; 2. a lying-in chamber; 3. the sanctuary of a temple, e.g. निर्गत्य गर्भभवनात् M.M.i.
गर्भ-ग्रहण n. impregnation, conception.
गर्भ-घातिन् a. producing abortion.
गर्भ-चलन n. quickening of the fœtus in the uterus.
गर्भ-च्युति f. 1. birth, delivery; 2. miscarriage.
गर्भेतृप्त a. contented as regards food or issue.
गर्भ-दास m. (fem. ˚सी) a slave by birth (used also as a term of abuse).
गर्भ-द्रुह् a. (nom. sing. धुक्) causing abortion.
गर्भ-धरा f. pregnant.
गर्भ-धारण n. jestation, impregnation.
गर्भ-धारणा f. jestation, impregnation.
गर्भ-ध्वंस m. abortion.
गर्भ-पाकिन् m. rice ripening in sixty days.
गर्भ-पात m. miscarriage after the fourth month of pregnancy.
गर्भ-पोषण n. nourishment of the fœtus.
गर्भ-भर्मन् n. supporting a fœtus, R.iii.12.
गर्भ-मंडप m. an inner apartment, a bed chamber.
गर्भ-मास m. month of pregnancy.
गर्भ-मोचन n. delivery, birth.
गर्भ-योषा f. 1. a pregnant woman; 2. the Ganges overflowing its banks (fig.).
गर्भ-रक्षण n. protecting the fœtus.
गर्भ-रूप, -रूपक m. a child, an infant, a youth.

गर्भ-लक्षण n. a symptom of pregnancy.
गर्भ-लंभन n. a ceremony performed for the sake of developing pregnancy.
गर्भ-वती f. a pregnant woman.
गर्भ-वसति f. 1. the womb, M.xii.78; 2. the being in the womb.
गर्भ-वास m. 1. the womb, M.xii.78; 2. the being in the womb.
गर्भ-विच्युति f. abortion in the beginning of pregnancy.
गर्भ-वेदना f. pains of childbirth.
गर्भ-व्याकरण n. the formation of the embryo.
गर्भ-शंकु m. a kind of instrument for extracting the dead fœtus.
गर्भ-संभव m. the incoming pregnant.
गर्भ-संभूति f. the incoming pregnant.
गर्भ-स्थ a. 1. situated in the womb; 2. intemal.
गर्भक (I) m. A chaplet of flowers worn in the hair.
गर्भक (II) n. A period of two nights with the intermediate day.
गर्भंड m. Enlargement of the navel.
गर्भिणी f. A pregnant woman or animal, गोगर्भिणीप्रियनवोलपमालभारिसेव्योपकंठविपिनावलयो भवंति M.M.ix., Yaj.i.105.
गर्भिणी-अवेक्षण n. mid-wifery, care of pregnant women and new-born infants.

गर्व् vt. 1P (pp. गर्वित) To be proud, to become haughty, e.g. कोऽर्थान् प्राप्य न गर्वितः Panch.i.

गर्व m. 1. Pride, arrogance, अहं लतायाः सदृशीत्यखर्वं गौरांगि गर्वं न कदापि कुर्याः R.G., तथा लता पल्लविनी सगर्वे Bh.V.ii.107; 2. pride considered as one of the 33 subordinate feelings (in rhetoric). (It is thus defined by the S.D.- गर्वो मदः प्रभावश्रीविद्यासत्कुलतादिजः । अवज्ञा सविलासांगदर्शनाऽविनयादिकृत्.)
गर्वाट m. A watchman, a doorkeeper.

गर्हण n. Censure, blame, abuse.

गर्ह्य-वादिन् a. speaking ill, speaking vilely.
गारुड (I) a. (f. डी) 1. Shaped like Garuḍa; 2. coming from or relating to Garuḍa.
